players.product: Niche DRAM (DDR4, DDR3L, LPDDR4X) plus NOR flash and SLC NAND flash (fabless)

quarterly_data.signal: Vice chairman and general manager He Wei (2025 annual results briefing): in Q1 2026 all the company's memory products faced tight supply with prices rising accordingly, while costs also rose mildly. VP and CFO Sun Guijing: with niche memory in shortage the company has shortened its price-negotiation cycle with downstream customers, and Q1 niche DRAM price changes will show in Q1 revenue and profit. Sun on the drivers: exploding AI-server demand for DDR5 and HBM made leading makers migrate to HBM and DDR5 and cut or abandon niche output, so niche DRAM prices rose sharply; AI-driven demand for 3D NAND (e.g. eSSD) led majors to cut 2D NAND capacity, and SLC NAND Flash prices have risen significantly since Q3 2025; NOR Flash supply turned relatively tight in H2 2025 as edge AI raised code size, lifting prices mildly.

He Wei (results briefing), niche DRAM targets: in the medium to long term the company aims to lead China's niche DRAM market (a market share of more than 30%); in 2026 it expects niche DRAM revenue to grow well year on year, helped by higher market prices and natural growth in its capacity. He named its levers as long, close cooperation with its supplier, fast product iteration (DDR4 8Gb launched last year gained share quickly; self-developed LPDDR4 to reach mass production this year; small-capacity LPDDR5 R&D starting) and long-term partnerships with TV, industrial (e.g. power) and AI-related customers rather than chasing short-term gross margin. CFO Sun Guijing: memory prices and gross margins have risen; later 2026 prices depend on supply and demand.
quarterly_data.figure: niche DRAM target share more than 30%

quarterly_data.signal: Board secretary Dong Lingyan (results briefing): automotive-grade Flash revenue grew well, with cumulative shipments above 3 hundred million units used in smart cockpits and assisted driving; GD32A7 automotive MCUs are entering volume production with design wins on several vehicle models, and cumulative shipments of the GD32A automotive MCU family exceed 800 ten-thousand units.
quarterly_data.figure: auto Flash cumulative shipments above 3 hundred million units; GD32A auto MCU above 800 ten-thousand units

quarterly_data.signal: He Wei (results briefing opening statement): the company's original analog chip business grew about 460% year on year in 2025, and subsidiary Suzhou Saixin met its 2025 performance commitment of net profit excluding non-recurring items of no less than RMB 7,000 ten-thousand; sensor-chip revenue and gross margin fell year on year on sharper competition in phones and tablets. He said the company must develop its other product lines in a more balanced way in 2026 while growing memory.

players.product: DDR5 (up to 8000Mbps), LPDDR4X, LPDDR5/5X and LPDDR6 DRAM chips, DDR5 RDIMM / MRDIMM / UDIMM / SODIMM and LPCAMM modules, and DRAM wafers

connects_to.relationship: DRAM product sales and foundry services to GigaDevice

contracts.signal: GigaDevice vice chairman and general manager He Wei (2025 annual results briefing), asked about the 2026 related-party estimate with CXMT: the 2026 estimated amount rises sharply year on year because new niche products and solutions are adding business demand and rising niche DRAM market prices have lifted wafer foundry costs significantly year on year.
